src.creator: The Cheat Code Kitchen
src.title: One Base. Five Ninja Creami Protein Ice Creams

recipes.title: Frosted Circus Crunch Protein Creami

items.i: vanilla bean paste or extract (½ tsp)
Circus Animal cookies, broken up (26 g)

steps: Blend
Blend the base until smooth (immersion blender or frother), adding the dry ingredients slowly while mixing, then keep blending 90 seconds.
Freeze
Pour into a Creami pint, lid on, and freeze on a level surface for 24 hours.
Spin
Run the pint under hot water for 1 minute, then spin on Lite Ice Cream. Re-spin if it's crumbly.
Mix in
Make a hole down the middle with a spoon or knife, add the mix-ins and run the Mix-in cycle.
recipes.notes: Base and mix-ins are the creator's, with his macros per pint. The same base works for all five flavors.
